entities.summary: Mykhailo Mykhailovych Korda is a Ukrainian scientist in the field medical biochemistry, Doctor of Sciences in Medicine (1998), Professor (2002), Corresponding Member of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine., Honored Science and Technology Figure of Ukraine (2017), Rector of I. Horbachevsky Ternopil National Medical University.
